description: Vietnam proforma financial and tax defaults. Single versioned source for the regulatory/commercial constants the proforma assumes, mirroring SAM's deploy/runtime/defaults/*.json. Edit values here; regulatory provenance is kept in code comments next to where each value is consumed.

surplus_export.description: Decree 243/2026/ND-CP (2026-06-26) amending Decree 58/2025: rooftop surplus sold to EVN, cap 50% of output (>50% negotiable until 2030-12-31 under grid-absorption conditions). Price = prior-year average electricity market price, capped at Decision 988/QD-BCT ground-mounted-solar (no storage) regional ceiling, excl. VAT.
